status: Single selected-column analog study; full readout and hardware validation pending
voltage_datum_note: Frequency-domain calculations use a centered numerical reference to avoid cold-bias failures in the vendor macromodel. Step and independent sine-wave checks use physical 0 V ground and start with PARK closed. These coordinates do not change hardware voltages.

operating_point_initial_guess.note: NODESET aids the nonlinear initial solve and is released by ngspice. It does not force the completed operating point or change circuit elements.

amplifier.model: TI OPAx392 PSpice model Final 1.1, August 2022
amplifier.selection_reason: The reviewed model reproduces approximately 45 degrees with a 100 pF load, matching the single DBV package's listed typical case. The quad package's current datasheet lists 35 degrees.
amplifier.limits: A typical, older manufacturer model is not a bound on component variation or a qualification of the finished circuit.

gain_selection.topology: Four independently controlled SPST switches; one selected switch connects the op-amp output to its resistor/capacitor branch.
gain_selection.logic: Active high; four physical pull-downs and firmware one-hot control
gain_selection.capacitance_note: The 17 pF typical on value is split into the cited 7 pF source and 10 pF drain off values for this lumped approximation; not a measured two-port model.

column_multiplexers.capacitance_note: The listed typical drain-off/source-off/on values are 180/13/200 pF. This study uses an explicit 180+20 pF split; it is not a transistor-level mux model.

interconnect.limits: Placeholder series paths for feedback dynamics; calculate the complete routed board/cable/flex network separately.

local_park_feedback.connection: Resistor: amplifier output to sense-mux drain, before RINPUT. Capacitor: amplifier output to the summing node, after RINPUT.
local_park_feedback.limits: The resistor carries DC current and changes effective transimpedance. Returning it before RINPUT avoids adding the input compensation resistor to that DC sense-current drop.

current_drain_shunt_note: A fixed C0G capacitor on the wrist board establishes a controlled minimum current-node capacitance while retaining the full declared range of sensor capacitance.

low_gain_compensation.control: Connect SEL to GAIN0. Active-low TMUX1102 bypasses the added resistor in gains 1-3; gain 0 retains the resistor.
low_gain_compensation.reason: Gain 0 needs stronger local compensation with lightly loaded sensor nodes. Keeping the extra resistance out of higher gains preserves their settling time.
low_gain_compensation.limits: The switch is modeled as a selected resistance plus stated capacitances. Gain-transition charge injection remains to be checked.

output_isolation_note: The amplifier pin drives the gain-bank/ADC-input bus through this resistor. Local parked feedback returns from the amplifier pin; the measured output is the bus after the resistor.

active_park_feedback.logic: High closes a local feedback path; hardware pull-up parks the amplifier during controller reset
active_park_feedback.note: TMUX1101 closes for logic high. Its 3.3 V table lists 9.8 ohm maximum on resistance through 125 C and 6/10/17 pF typical source-off/drain-off/on capacitances. This lumped model uses 10 ohm and 10 pF at each terminal; charge injection and component variation remain to be checked.
active_park_feedback.dc_initialization: Continue PARK from closed to open for each DC endpoint. Transient sources specify the true parked initial DC value, then release PARK before excitation. AC calculations use the solved centered-reference bias.

main_adc_candidate.previous_main_adc_candidate: MCP3208, 12 bits; still a candidate for row/reference monitoring
main_adc_candidate.reason: At a nominal 3.3 V reference, 16 bits with 39.2 kohm corresponds to about 1.28 nA per code, versus 1.61 nA per code for 12 bits with 499 kohm. Lower feedback resistance reduces the strong-load noise gain and settling burden.
main_adc_candidate.limits: Nominal code spacing is not achieved resolution or force accuracy. ADC noise, INL, reference drive, input settling, interface timing and physical calibration still need validation.

voltage_return_ratio_screen.limits: Voltage injection at the high-impedance amplifier input is a development screen, not a formal multi-loop stability guarantee. Check closed-loop transients as well.

transient.limits: The current step exercises a linear-range readout response. It has no associated force or contact probability.

remaining: Row-buffer loops and the complete coupled array
Gain/channel changes, charge injection, overload recovery and wire faults
Reference ladder, ADC buffer/acquisition and raw scan protocol
